lessons.title: Practice ORDER BY LIMIT
lessons.description: Sort products by price descending and keep only the top 3. The test checks that the result has exactly 3 rows.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: list product name and price, most expensive first, only the top 3
SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — SELECT — ORDER BY sorting and LIMIT clause

learning_objectives: Harbor potters recount crates before dawn, and sort result sets with ORDER BY, descending when needed.

exercises.question: Harbor potters recount crates before dawn. For sort result sets with ORDER BY, descending when needed, which line returns the first name in sorted order?
hints: Compare each line with the example.
